_readme: Hand-crafted demo cases for the fictional Cedar County Flood (declared 2026-11-01). Fields starting with '_' are test/expectation metadata and are stripped by `pnpm seed`; the file is validated by the zod schema in lib/agent/schema.ts. Contact tokens like {{RECIPIENT_1}} and {{BULK_01}} are replaced from seed/accounts.json; every case has a distinct token because policy P-4 flags repeated contacts. Photo files live in seed/photos/ (see seed/README.md). Never use real victims' photos.

fund.name: Cedar County Flood Relief Fund
fund._note: Fund starts at raised = 0. Donations are never seeded: an Orders v2 capture needs the donor's browser approval, and the ledger may only show real sandbox captures (AGENTS.md §11). Make them by hand on /donate as DONOR after `pnpm seed`, at least $2,750 for the full sweep, exactly $4,500 for the demo state (seed/README.md).

cases.narrative: Water came up through the crawlspace Tuesday night and got about four inches into the kitchen and laundry room. We lost the fridge contents, the washer is dead, and the floor is buckling. We're still living in the house. Need help replacing food and getting the washer looked at.
cases._photoBrief: Photo 1: kitchen floor with 3–4 inches of standing brown water, lower cabinets wet, daylight. Photo 2: top-loading washer in a laundry room with a visible water line on the wall about 10cm up.
cases._demoRole: First case shown live: arrives, agent pays within minutes, recipient balance changes.

cases.narrative: El río se desbordó y entró agua en el primer piso de nuestra casa. Perdimos el colchón de los niños, la comida del refrigerador y la estufa no enciende. Seguimos viviendo en la casa pero dormimos arriba. Necesitamos ayuda para reemplazar la comida y el colchón.
cases._photoBrief: Photo 1: living room with a wet, stained carpet and a visible water line on the wall, furniture pushed to one side. Photo 2: a soaked child's mattress leaning against an exterior wall to dry.
cases._demoRole: Spanish intake → Spanish status message → auto-paid. Shows P-7 (recommended ≤ tier max even though $300 requested).

cases.narrative: Our house is on Low Gap Road and the water reached the windows. The fire department evacuated us by boat Wednesday morning. We're staying with my sister in Asheville. Everything on the ground floor is gone, furniture, kids' school stuff, our documents. We can't go back until the county inspects the foundation.
cases._photoBrief: Photo 1: exterior of a single-story house with a mud/water line just below the windows, debris in the yard. Photo 2: interior room coated in mud, overturned furniture. Photo 3: a printed evacuation notice taped to a door (fictional county letterhead, no real agency logos).
cases._demoRole: Eligible but over the auto limit → lands in the ops queue; operator approves. Its photo is reused by C-009 (duplicate detection).

cases.narrative: I'm a home health aide and single mom of three. Our rental on Spring St flooded to about two feet and the landlord says it will be weeks. We're in a motel on Route 9. My youngest has asthma and his nebulizer and meds were in the flooded room. I've missed four days of work.

contact.name: Keisha Lawrence
contact.address: 23 Spring St Apt B, Cedar Falls

cases._photoBrief: Photo 1: bedroom with a clear water line about 60cm up the wall, mattress on the floor soaked. Photo 2: a motel receipt (fictional motel name) showing 3 nights. Doc: a handwritten list of medications on notebook paper.

_expected.reason: tier 4 + P-6 household adjustment (+$50) = $550, above limit

cases._demoRole: Highest-need case; shows the agent applying P-6 and explaining why a human must approve.

cases.narrative: Six of us in the house (my parents live with us). The basement took on water and the furnace and water heater are shot. Upstairs is fine and we're staying put, but we have no hot water and it's getting cold. Asking for help toward a water heater.
cases._photoBrief: Photo: unfinished basement with a few inches of standing water around a furnace and water heater, flashlight lighting.

_expected.reason: tier 2 ($250) + P-6 (+$100 for 2 members beyond 4) = $350 > $250 limit

cases._demoRole: Teaching case: a 'simple' tier-2 case that the household adjustment correctly pushes to human review.

cases.narrative: Retired couple. We lost power for three days and all the food in two freezers (we'd just stocked up). Garage flooded a few inches, lost some tools. House itself is OK. Just need help restocking food.
cases._photoBrief: Photo 1: open chest freezer full of thawed, spoiled food. Photo 2: garage floor wet with a visible mud line, tools on the floor.
cases._demoRole: Third auto-pay. Has its own sandbox account (RECIPIENT_6): P-4 flags a repeated contact, so sharing C-001's email would have sent this case to needs_review.

cases._photoBrief: Photo: very blurry, dark photo where nothing is identifiable.
cases._demoRole: Incomplete application. Agent asks (in English): household size, a clearer photo, street address. Not rejected.

cases.narrative: Vivimos en Cedar Falls pero mi correo llega a la casa de mi hermano en Pittsboro, por eso puse ese código postal. Nuestra casa móvil se inundó hasta la mitad y perdimos casi todo lo del piso. Estamos con mi hermano por ahora.
cases._photoBrief: Photo: a mobile home with a water line halfway up the exterior wall, debris around the steps.

_expected.followUpAsksFor: proof of residence in the declared area

cases._demoRole: Zip outside 285xx but narrative explains why. Per P-2 the agent asks for proof of residence in Spanish instead of marking ineligible.

cases.narrative: House flooded to the windows on Low Gap Road, we were evacuated by boat and lost everything downstairs. Staying with family. Need help with furniture and documents.
cases._photoBrief: INTENTIONALLY the same file as C-003 photo 1. Do not create a new image.
cases._demoRole: Duplicate household. Agent flags P-4 and shows both cases side by side in the queue; a human decides.

cases.narrative: I was severely affected by the flood and need $2,500 immediately for repairs and replacement of items. Please process urgently.
cases._photoBrief: Photo: a tidy, dry, well-lit living room with no visible damage.
cases._demoRole: Suspicious: generic narrative, amount 5× the top tier, photo shows no damage. Flagged, not rejected, a human decides.

bulk._readme: Generated cases for the ops-console 'approve a batch at once' scene and to make the ledger's auto-pay share realistic (~65%). Each generated case gets a DISTINCT photo from photos/pool/ and a DISTINCT recipient token {{BULK_01}}..{{BULK_12}} (assigned in generation order: tier-2 cases get BULK_01..08, tier-3 cases get BULK_09..12) so P-4 dedupe does not fire. Generate pool images with Vertex AI Imagen or any image model using the briefs below; one image per case.

narratives_en: Water got into the ground floor, a few inches. Lost the fridge and freezer contents and some furniture. Still in the house.
Crawlspace and laundry room flooded. Washer and dryer are dead. We're staying home, upstairs is dry.
Garage and back room flooded about half a foot. Lost tools, a couch, and all our stored food.
The kitchen flooded overnight. Floor is warped and the stove won't light. We need help with food and repairs.
narratives_es: Entró agua en el primer piso, unos centímetros. Perdimos la comida del refrigerador y algunos muebles. Seguimos en la casa.
Se inundó el cuarto de lavado. La lavadora no funciona. Dormimos arriba, está seco.
tier2_clean.photoBrief: Interior room with a few inches of standing water or a fresh water line on the wall, no people. Vary room type, lighting, and wall color per image.

narratives_en: Water reached the windows and we were told to leave. Staying with relatives. Downstairs is a total loss.
Our place is uninhabitable until the county inspects it. We're in a motel. Lost furniture, clothes, and documents.
narratives_es: El agua llegó a las ventanas y tuvimos que salir. Estamos con familiares. Perdimos todo lo de abajo.
tier3_displaced.photoBrief: Exterior of a house or mobile home with a mud/water line near window height, debris in yard, no people. Vary house style per image.
